sources.paired_digest_definition: SHA256 of sorted condition_name + NUL + individual NPZ SHA256 + newline records

verification.trusted_scorer_full_suite_replay: Selected correlated hard predictions reconstructed from actual XOR error, temporary probabilities used only to verify decision-metric aggregation; no calibrated-confidence claim

resources.resource_note: Two cores were allocated; this is measured offline evaluation time, not streaming decoding latency.

split.calibration_caveat: Released even-calibrated DEM uses ALL even syndromes, including validation. It uses neither validation labels nor odd test syndromes/labels. Validation is label-held-out, not fully held out from unsupervised DEM estimation.

methodology.conditions: Four d3 patches and one d5 patch, X/Z bases, 13 odd round counts 1..25
methodology.selection: separately for MWPM and correlated, choose one global calibration minimizing the equal-distance mean of macro LER on validation; ties favor circuit DEM
methodology.metric: Weighted least squares: log(1-2 P_fail(r)) = intercept + slope*r; epsilon = (1-exp(slope))/2
methodology.distance_macro: Equal mean of separately fitted basis/patch logical error rates: 8 groups at d3, 2 at d5

uncertainty.method: per-condition parametric binomial bootstrap with complete refitting
uncertainty.assumptions: independent shots and conditions; conditional on circuits; no drift or model-seed uncertainty

methodology.suppression_note: d3 macro / d5 macro is descriptive across different measured patches; it is not a threshold demonstration.
methodology.historical_reference_note: BP and tensor-network values rescore released predictions, rather than newly reproducing those decoder implementations.
methodology.fit_diagnostic_note: F0=exp(intercept)>1 is an unphysical extrapolation to r=0 of an unconstrained fit trained on r=3..25. It does not imply probabilities above one on observed rounds. Retain the diagnostics and reduced chi-square; no condition was filtered and high R-squared does not establish exact exponential decay.

benchmark_assessment.suitability: Suitable as a fixed-device decoding-learning benchmark with strong executable classical baselines and paired held-out evaluation. Neural baseline convergence remains a separate completion requirement.

d3.interpretation: Observed comparison on the same held-out shots; TN is an achieved reference, not a Bayes-optimal ceiling.

d5.interpretation: Observed comparison on the same held-out shots; TN is an achieved reference, not a Bayes-optimal ceiling.

benchmark_assessment.calibration: Neural official-path probabilities support secondary NLL and Brier proper scores. Current classical/reference artifacts provide hard decisions only, so no classical confidence calibration is claimed. NLL/Brier combine accuracy and calibration and do not replace reliability diagnostics.
benchmark_assessment.public_test: The released odd-shot labels and historical predictions are public. The current split is a documented development protocol, not a blind contamination-resistant benchmark; independent hidden data would be required for that claim.
benchmark_assessment.generalization_limit: d3/d5 on this processor does not establish distance-11 behavior, another processor, soft-readout performance, or real-time fault-tolerant decoding.
